The District Postmistress
W.C.D.O.

If delivery of the letter can be traced please say that signature is on the delivery receipt.

W. Goodrich
1.B. (Special Section)
4 January 40

The 1B Special Section

The relative delivering slip was signed by the woman housekeeper A. NORRINGTON. A tracing of her signature appearing on the slip is attached in columns.

WB50 5-6-40
W.G. Blundery
for Palmeston
